attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and FY 2026-27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE on November 16, 2026. The call was held on November 13, 2026. Managing Director Vedant Bang reported Q2 revenue from operations grew 39% year-on-year to INR 79 crores. EBITDA stood at INR 11 crores with a margin of 13.31%. Profit after tax was INR 6 crores, up 34% year-on-year. First half revenue grew 31% to INR 145 crores. The company secured exclusive licensing rights for Forever 21 and Dockers in South Asia. It also entered international markets through exports. Men's apparel contributed 76% of H1 FY27 revenue. Fulfillment cost per unit declined to INR 18 in H1 FY27.

attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshadweep on November 14, 2026. Separately, Abans Enterprises Limited issued a notice of postal ballot. The company sought member approval for special and ordinary resolutions via remote e-voting. The postal ballot notice was dispatched on November 6, 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility was November 6, 2026. The notice is available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of audio recording
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited has hosted the audio recording of the earnings call for the second quarter and full financial year 2026-27. The call was held on November 13, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST. The recording is available on the company website at the specified link. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company secretary and compliance officer, Rashi Bang, submitted this notice to the BSE and NSE for information and record.

attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The document outlines the company's transition to a tech-enabled online fashion retailer. H1 FY27 revenue breakdown shows 96% from B2C and 4% from B2B. Operational income for H1 FY27 was 1,447 million INR with an EBITDA margin of 13.13%. The company operates 4 manufacturing plants with a total capacity of 140,000 units per month and 4 fulfillment centers. Key metrics include a 3-year PAT CAGR of 88% and a 3-year revenue CAGR of 60%. The board comprises Brijgopal Bang, Vedant Bang, Vandana Bang, Usha Ghelani, Kavita Chhajer, and Anuradha Paraskar. The presentation highlights the launch of GenAI tools named thread.ai and catalog.ai in pilot stages.

attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 7,892.11 lakhs for the quarter and 14,473.96 lakhs for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 811.36 lakhs for the quarter and 1,499.54 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 628.51 lakhs for the quarter and 1,172.32 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 4.26 for the quarter and 7.97 for the half year. Total assets were 26,168.83 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The financial statements were reviewed by Bharat Gupta and Co.
